cases.id: replacing a value that looks like a comment replaces it whole
cases.note: A `#` is a comment only at a line's start, so `#c` here is the value.

deleteKey removes the only entry, leaving an empty file
deleteKey and renameKey on a repeated key take every spelling
comment ops: leading works with '#', trailing is unsupported
cases.note: Zig error CommentsUnsupported. A `#` after a value is value text, so `flag # note` would read back as `flag` = `# note`. Refused, and nothing is written.

cases.id: a comment or entry written after a continued last line ends the continuation first [1]
cases.note: `trail=v\` continues onto the next line, so a line written straight after it would be read as the rest of `trail`'s value. The Zig test also reads `trail` (and `n`) back, which the bytes pin: the continued line is followed by a blank one.

cases.id: a comment or entry written after a continued last line ends the continuation first [4]
